evals.prompt: What resource types does Linear declare for Kei policy?
evals.expected_output: Per ADR-028: team (no parent), issue (parent: team), project (parent: team), cycle (parent: team), and user (no parent).
expectations: lists team, issue, project, cycle, user

checks.text: lists team, issue, project, cycle, user

evals.prompt: How does pagination work in the Linear API?
evals.expected_output: Linear uses cursor-based pagination. Every list field accepts `first` (limit) and `after` (cursor). The response includes `pageInfo` with `hasNextPage` and `endCursor`. There is no offset or page-based pagination.

evals.prompt: I'm the Kei org admin. I want my team to use Linear through Kei the way the Linear MCP works: everyone signs in to Linear in the browser and there's no API key to copy. Walk me through creating the Linear connector and tell me how I get its connector ID.
evals.expected_output: Run `kei connectors create --workspace W --provider linear --account-model per_user --name linear`; it prints `Connector instance ID: <id>`. Each user then connects their own Linear account from their harness (OAuth consent in the browser); `kei connectors reconnect` does not apply to per_user. Check with `kei connectors get <id> --workspace W` (State: connected) or find the ID later with `kei connectors list --workspace W`. Note: Linear sign-in is not available yet because the hosted Linear OAuth app is not configured.
expectations: gives the kei connectors create command with --provider linear
says how to read the connector ID (create output, connectors get, or connectors list)
describes OAuth sign-in rather than an API key

evals.prompt: We want Pedro on Discord to file bugs into Linear. I already have a Linear personal API key. How do I create the Linear connector with --credential-ref, and where does the connector ID go so KEI_CONNECTOR_LINEAR_ID is set?
evals.expected_output: The API-key path is not available yet: Linear setup is OAuth only and `kei connectors create --provider linear` rejects `--credential-ref`. For a bot, create a shared OAuth connector (`--account-model shared`), then `kei connectors reconnect <id> --workspace W` and approve the consent URL. The connector ID is not a secret: set the Helm value `keiProxy.runtime.linearConnectorID` in helm/pedro-discord/values-<env>.yaml, which sets KEI_CONNECTOR_LINEAR_ID. Note: `file_bug` needs `issue.create`, which the runtime does not run yet (capability_not_supported); only reads run.
expectations: says the API key / --credential-ref path is not available for Linear
recommends the shared account model for the bot
names the Helm value linearConnectorID as where the ID goes
flags that issue.create writes do not run yet
